verdict.rationale: An agency that runs online employer tax and wage filing could plausibly publish an API reference for payroll software, so this axis applies. The evidence shows none: every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returns 404, llms.txt and markdown docs are absent, and the documented filing paths are the EAMS web portal behind a SecureAccess Washington login, paper forms, and how-to videos. Nothing points to an interactive API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
